name: Aman Singh
bio: Aman Singh is Lead AI Engineer at Arca, an AI-native wealth management company in New York. He is a founding member of the technical staff on Arca's AI engineering team (joined November 2025) and leads the company's AI work, including the long-horizon agents that run core business operations. Before Arca, he worked at Stripe, where he helped establish Stripe's AI agent framework that powers all agents company-wide. He studied at The Ohio State University and is based in New York.

sessions.title: Inside Arca's long-horizon agents that run the business
